items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This is a trio. Everett Boxdale, Eddie South, and myself.

ctx.x: We got a job at the… at least I got a job in a club on Sunset Boulevard called the Club Ballyhoo, another small club. All of the violin players in the movie theater… orchestra, they‟d heard about Eddie . We‟ve only got three pieces now. This is a trio. Everett Boxdale, Eddie South, and myself.
